Given a time-dependent directed graph 𝐺 (𝑉 , 𝐸, 𝐹 ), two nodes 𝑠, 𝑡 ∈ 𝑉 , and a departure time 𝜏, the problem of Time-Dependent Minimum Travel Time Query (short for TDMTTQ) is to find the minimum travel time from 𝑠 to 𝑡 at departure time 𝜏. This query is formally denoted as 𝑄 = (𝑠, 𝑡, 𝜏), while the minimum travel time is represented as 𝐷 (𝑠, 𝑡, 𝜏). Definition 3 (Time-Dependent Minimum Travel Time Path / Shortest Path).
